title: Create a duration formatting module with tests
description:
In the workspace, create a small Node.js (ESM) package that exports `formatDuration(ms)` and `parseDuration(text)`.

Requirements:
- Language: JavaScript (Node ESM). Create package.json with "type": "module" and a `test` script.
- Use the built-in test runner: `node --test`.
- formatDuration(ms): returns a compact human string. Under 1000ms returns `${ms}ms`. Under 60s returns `${s}s`. Under 60m returns `${m}m ${s}s`. Otherwise `${h}h ${m}m`.
- parseDuration(text): parses '90s', '2m 30s', '1h 5m' back into milliseconds. Throws a TypeError for input it cannot parse.
- Files: package.json, src/index.js, test/index.test.js (or equivalent).
- Write real tests covering: milliseconds, seconds, minutes+seconds, hours+minutes, the 59s/60s boundary, round-tripping parseDuration(formatDuration(ms)), and the TypeError case.
- Run `npm test` (or `node --test`) and make sure every test passes before you report DONE.
acceptanceCriteria: package.json exists with type=module and a test script that runs the tests
test files exist and exercise the cases listed in the description
